comment: The ships which Signe the shipwright builds in her shipyard, and how they row: the push of a stroke, how long the ship glides, how quickly it turns and how fast it can go, as shares of the small rowing boat; how far its bow reaches ahead (in metres, it must stay on the water); the hold in crates; the crew which rows to the players' beat; and how the ship is drawn ("drawn", see Longship.look: its painted hull, crew, oars, sail and cargo, placed in the pixels of the hull picture (y from its bow end, x from its middle), its length in metres, and the stern bench where the players row). See GameState and DESIGN.md, section 8.

ships.name: rowing boat
ships.about: Grandmother's old boat: small, nimble, and yours.

ships.name: færing
ships.about: A light four-oared boat: two of my rowers pull with you.

ships.name: karve
ships.about: A small ship with six rowers and a square sail which keeps her gliding.

ships.name: knarr
ships.about: The trading ship: wide and deep, she carries forty crates, but she turns slowly.

ships.name: longship
ships.about: Twenty rowers and a great sail: the fastest ship on the lakes.
